test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2025 - General Knowledge (Held On: 15th_September_2025_Shift_3)
subject: general
question:
**Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct options:**

**Assertion (A):** SVAMITVA scheme provides property cards using drone technology.

**Reason (R):** It covers rural and urban areas.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

solution:
The correct answer is __**A is true, but R is false**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **SVAMITVA** stands for **Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas**, launched by the Government of India in April 2020.
 
• The scheme aims to map rural inhabited lands using **drone technology** and provides property cards to the owners of these lands.
 
• It is implemented by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, in collaboration with State Revenue Departments.
 
• The property cards generated under this scheme serve as legal ownership documents for rural inhabitants.
 
• **SVAMITVA** focuses exclusively on rural areas and does not cover urban regions, making Reason (R) incorrect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Drone Technology in SVAMITVA:**

 
 
• Drones are used to conduct surveys and create high-resolution maps of rural inhabited lands.
 
• The use of drones ensures accuracy and reduces disputes over property boundaries.
 
• This modern technology enables the creation of a robust digital land record system in rural India.
 
 
 
• **Coverage of SVAMITVA:**
 
 
• The scheme is limited to rural areas and is not extended to urban regions.
 
• The primary objective is to empower rural citizens by providing legal ownership of their properties.
 
• Urban areas are covered under separate land record programs.
